google.connectSubtitle: Bring your Google contacts into the system as customers. Nothing in your Google account is changed.

signIn.text: Use the Google account that has the contacts you want.

allow.text: The system only reads them. It never edits or deletes anything in Google.

detail.1: Google shows a screen asking to "see and download your contacts".
detail.2: Keep that box ticked. Without it the system cannot list your contacts.
detail.3: The access is read-only: nothing in your Google account is edited, created or deleted.

choose.title: Choose who becomes a customer
choose.text: Review the list, pick the contacts you want and save. People who already are customers are only linked.

need.1: A Google account where your contacts are saved, the same one your phone syncs to.
need.2: Contacts saved in Google Contacts (contacts.google.com). Those kept only on the phone or the SIM are not included.
need.3: Room in your plan for new customers: the page shows how many you can still add.

works.1: The list of your Google contacts, to look through before saving anything.
works.2: You pick the ones that become customers. Nothing is saved without your choice.
works.3: Contacts that already match a customer by e-mail are only linked to it, and nothing on that customer changes.

limits.1: The access is read-only: the system never edits, creates or deletes anything in Google.
limits.2: Up to 2,000 contacts are listed at a time, and the list is refreshed at most every 20 minutes.
limits.3: Each account connects one Google account, and you can switch to another by disconnecting.

1.q: Which Google account should I use?
1.a: The one that has the contacts you want as customers. It can be your personal account or the company's.

2.q: Some of my contacts are missing.
2.a: Only contacts saved in your Google account are listed ("My contacts"). Contacts stored only on the phone or the SIM, and the ones Google suggests as "Other contacts", are not included.

3.q: Will this change my Google contacts?
3.a: No. The permission is read-only. The system only reads, and your Google account stays exactly as it is.

4.q: Google warns that the app is not verified.
4.a: While the app is under review, Google may show a warning. Choose Advanced and continue to the app. If you are unsure, contact support first.

5.q: How do I switch accounts or stop the access?
5.a: Use Disconnect on this page and connect again with another account. You can also remove the access in your Google account, under Security.

1.q: Why do I log in with Facebook?
1.a: Facebook is how you authorize this system to read and answer your Page's messages. The login is on Facebook's own screen and you can remove the access at any time in Facebook's settings, under Business integrations.

2.q: My Page does not show up in the list.
2.a: You need to be an admin of the Page. If it belongs to a Meta Business portfolio, ask for access to it with permission to manage messages. Then connect again and tick it on Facebook's screen.

3.q: I connected, but a customer's message did not arrive.
3.a: Only messages sent after the connection are received. Messages that Facebook keeps in "Message requests" arrive after the Page accepts them. If it still does not show up, contact support.

4.a: Not yet. This connection is only for Facebook Messenger.

5.a: Use the Disconnect button on this page. Conversations already received stay here, and nothing changes on your Page.

telegram.connectSubtitle: Answer the customers who write to your bot without leaving the system.
telegram.tokenInvalid: This does not look like a bot token. It is numbers, a colon, then letters and digits.

need.1: A Telegram account, on your phone or on the computer.
need.2: About two minutes to create the bot, which is free.
need.3: No Telegram Business account is needed: a bot is enough.

works.1: Everyone who writes to your bot shows up in the inbox here, in real time.
works.2: You answer from this system with text, photos, files and voice messages.
works.3: Each person can be linked to a customer, or become one with a click.

limits.1: A bot cannot start a conversation: the customer writes first, by opening your bot's link.
limits.2: Each account has one bot, and a bot can belong to only one account.
limits.3: The token is the bot's password. Anyone who has it controls the bot, so never share it.

1.q: Where do customers find the bot?
1.a: Send them the link t.me/your_bot_username. After connecting, the button "Open in Telegram" shows it.

2.q: Can I use my personal Telegram account instead of a bot?
2.a: No. Telegram only lets systems talk to customers through bots. The bot is a separate identity, and your personal account is never touched.

3.q: I lost the token. What now?
3.a: Open @BotFather, send /mybots, pick your bot and choose API Token. You can also revoke it there and paste the new one here.

4.a: It is stored encrypted and never shown again. Disconnecting the bot here removes it.

5.q: I pasted the token and it was refused.
5.a: Copy the whole token, with the number, the colon and the letters, and no spaces. If you revoked it in BotFather, paste the new one.

need.2: A professional account (Business or Creator). Switching is free and takes a minute.
need.3: Message access turned on for connected tools, in Instagram's settings.
need.4: Nothing else: you do not need a Facebook Page.

works.1: The direct messages your account receives show up here in real time.
works.2: You answer from this system, within the 24 hours Instagram allows.
works.3: What you or your team send from the Instagram app also shows here.
works.4: Each person can be linked to a customer, or become one with a click.

limits.1: Instagram only allows answering within 24 hours after the customer's last message. After that, wait for the next one.
limits.2: For now you answer with text. Photos, videos and audio that customers send are shown here.
limits.3: Likes, shared posts and other things Instagram does not carry show as "not supported".
limits.4: Each user connects one account, and an account can belong to only one user.

1.q: How do I switch to a professional account?
1.a: In the Instagram app, open Settings and privacy, go to Account type and tools and choose Switch to professional account. Pick Business or Creator. It is free, and you can switch back.

2.q: Do I need a Facebook Page?
2.a: No. This connection uses only your Instagram account.

3.q: I connected, but a message did not arrive.
3.a: Check that Allow access to messages is on, under Messages and story replies, Message controls, Connected tools. Only messages sent after the connection are received, and the ones Instagram keeps in "Message requests" arrive after you accept them. If it still does not show up, contact support.

4.q: Why does it say the connection expired?
4.a: Instagram's access lasts 60 days and renews while you use the system. If it stays unused for long, it runs out. Connect again and everything comes back; the conversations you already have stay.

5.q: Can I send photos or audio?
5.a: Not yet. You can read and see the ones customers send, and answer with text.

business.title: Have your business at Meta
business.text: WhatsApp Business is tied to a Meta business account. If you do not have one, you can create it during the connection.

detail.1: You log in with the Facebook account that manages the business.
detail.2: If there is no business yet, Facebook walks you through creating it.
detail.3: Meta may ask for business details (name, website) to verify it.

number.title: Pick the number
number.text: The number your customers will write to. It becomes a WhatsApp Business number.

detail.1: It must not be in use on the regular WhatsApp app, or you can move it during the connection.
detail.2: You will receive a code by SMS or call at that number to confirm it is yours.
detail.3: You can keep using the WhatsApp Business app on the same number if Meta offers it.

login.title: Connect with Facebook
login.text: A Facebook window opens. Follow its steps and, in the end, come back here.

detail.1: Log in and choose or create your business.
detail.2: Add or choose the WhatsApp number and confirm the code.
detail.3: Allow this system to receive and send messages.

need.1: A Facebook account that manages your business (Meta Business).
need.2: A phone number for WhatsApp Business, able to receive an SMS or a call.
need.3: The number is not in use on a regular WhatsApp account, or you are ready to move it.
need.4: Your business details, in case Meta asks to verify them.

works.1: The messages your number receives show up here in real time, together with the other channels.
works.2: You answer from this system, with text, files and voice messages.
works.3: Each person can be linked to a customer, or become one with a click.
works.4: The conversation of a customer shows every channel together in Chats.

limits.1: WhatsApp only allows free answers within 24 hours after the customer's last message. After that, wait for their next one.
limits.2: Starting a conversation, or answering after 24 hours, needs a message template approved by Meta, which is not available here yet.
limits.3: Messages cannot be deleted through WhatsApp's API: removing one here is not possible.
limits.4: Each user connects one number, and a number can belong to only one user.

1.q: Do I lose my WhatsApp on the phone?
1.a: A number moved to the WhatsApp Business Platform stops working on the regular WhatsApp app. During the connection Meta may offer to keep using the WhatsApp Business app on the same number. Read what the Facebook window offers before accepting.

2.a: Connecting is free here. Meta charges for some messages, mostly the ones you start outside the 24-hour window. Answers within the window are usually free.

3.q: Why does the Facebook window not open?
3.a: Allow pop-ups for this site in your browser and try again.

4.q: Can I connect more than one number?
4.a: Not for now: each user has one WhatsApp number.

5.q: What if I want to stop?
5.a: Disconnect the number here. The conversations already received stay in the system.

mocks.openedBanner: The mock “{name}” is open in the editor.

TOP.label: Top
TOP.hint: A bar across the top of the page.

BOTTOM.label: Bottom
BOTTOM.hint: A bar always at the foot of the screen.

LEFT.label: Left
LEFT.hint: A column down the left side; on a phone it goes to the top.

RIGHT.label: Right
RIGHT.hint: A column down the right side; on a phone it goes to the top.

header.orderHint: Drag a part onto another to change its place, or use the arrows. Each part can sit to the left, the centre or the right of its place: the menu in the middle aligned right goes next to the buttons.
header.cleanHint: 0% is a solid background; 100% is no background at all. With any, at the top the header lies over the entrance, without taking room.
header.colorHint: Empty, the colour of the site. Useful over a dark photo or a dark background.
header.backgroundHint: Empty, the background colour of the site.
header.sizeHint: In pixels. Empty, the usual size.
header.buttonsHint: Buttons of your own in the header, beside the sign-in and the cart: to a page, WhatsApp, phone, e-mail or a link.
header.menuOrderHint: Drag an item, or use the arrows. Moving a page changes the order of the pages too.
header.menuOrderEmpty: No page is in the menu. Turn one on in Pages.
header.actionsOrderHint: Drag to change the order, or use the arrows: each of your buttons, the sign-in and the cart, one by one.
header.buttonSizeHint: For your buttons and the sign-in. The size of the cart button is set in the Bag tab.
header.shadowHint: 0% is no shadow; 100% is the strongest. It falls under a header at the top, over one at the bottom and beside one down a side.

border.label: Border
border.hint: On the edge of the header that faces the page: below it at the top, above it at the bottom, beside it down a side.

style.label: Style
style.hint: A ready look. The colours, transparency, shadow and border below still apply over it.

names.FLOATING: Floating — a pill away from the edges
names.BOLD: Bold — a band of the main colour
names.LINE: Line — closed by a line of the main colour
names.BOXED: Boxed — a squared frame with a hard shadow
names.ATELIER: Atelier — pastel band with a dotted hem
names.AURORA: Aurora — glass with a moving gradient ring
names.IMPACT: Impact — loud capitals over a bold line
names.RIVIERA: Riviera — thin capitals over a hairline
names.MARE: Maré — warm bar with a double line
names.SWELL: Swell — slanted, cut on a diagonal
names.BUDDY: Buddy — a round sticker with stitches
names.ATLAS: Atlas — sober, squared, a thin line
names.NEBULA: Nebula — deep glass with a halo
